name: Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference Using Lookahead Decoding (arXiv:2402.02057)
notes: arXiv:2402.02057. Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference Using Lookahead Decoding. By Yichao Fu et al. (UC Berkeley). Submitted 2024-02-03. Parallel decoding algorithm that accelerates LLM inference without auxiliary models. Up to 1.8x speedup on MT-bench.
